en: The postcard consists of two sides: the front features a black-and-white photograph of a large neoclassical building labeled 'TEATERN' (the theater) above the entrance, with a person riding a horse carriage in the foreground. The text below the image reads 'SUNDSVALL. TEATERN.' The reverse contains handwritten text in Swedish, an address, and a Swedish postage stamp with a postmark from Sundsvall. Standard postcard elements are present, including space for a message and address.
